Subject: Feedback on Your Recent Budget Increase Request

Dear [Recipient's Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase for your department. We appreciate the effort you put into outlining your needs.

After careful review, we have decided not to approve the request at this time. The justification provided does not currently align with the company’s broader financial strategy.

However, we encourage you to resubmit your request. To improve the chances of approval, please include a more detailed explanation along with concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. This additional context will help us better understand the value and impact of your proposal.

If you have any questions or need further clarification, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
